name: Tachibana Minami
source:
Minami is a 3rd Year. President of the Broadcast Club. She loves Takurou since she very depressed after a certain incident and he saved her.

Minami is very grateful that Takurou joined the Broadcast Club when it was on the verge of disbandment.Because of that, she spoils Takurou in various ways.  She loves Takurou very much. She gives off the air of being silent and cool, but is actually a very gentle girl. Her father is the school principal.

"This summer is surely the last time I can do something with everyone..."
